purpose: Phase 5 — Final Audit & Closure (Task 5 / AC8). Final full-repo quality-gate schema. The w5 Red-phase TDD suite asserts this fixture exists with the required top-level categories (npm_ls, npm_audit, boundary_check, per_app_quality_gates, single_root_lockfile_invariant) and per-migration subsections (W5-T1 tailwind, W5-T2 katex+lucide, W5-T3 jsdom). Green behavior: a w5 Green commit (per-migration) runs the actual quality-gate commands for that migration and writes the results into the matching per_migration_quality_gates entry.

npm_ls.summary: Clean. No dependency-tree problems across the 5 apps and 19 active shared packages. Required to hold after EACH W5 per-migration install. AC3 invariant.

npm_audit.summary: 0 critical / 0 high. The 14 moderate advisories dispositioned in w3-advisory-disposition.json remain dispositioned; W5 majors must not introduce new critical/high findings. AC2 invariant.

boundary_check.summary: No monorepo boundary violations after W5 final majors. W5 must not introduce a new cross-boundary import (test-strategy.md §4).

per_app_quality_gates.purpose: Per-app lint/test/typecheck/build status captured after EACH W5 per-migration install (Task 5.1). Each migration commit re-runs the full per-app gate so a wave that flips a previously-green app to red is attributable to that migration.

single_root_lockfile_invariant.purpose: Cross-check the npm ls result against the filesystem: exactly one package-lock.json at the repo root, zero nested. See also lockfile-inventory.json (AC7, FR10).

pre_existing_failures.policy: Per spec Out-of-Scope, pre-existing failures unrelated to the upgrade are not auto-fixed; they are recorded here for attribution. W5 must not introduce NEW pre-existing failures (count delta must be zero). If a wave resolves one of these as a side effect, mark it resolved with the wave SHA. Green-time fixture population owed by a follow-up commit (per W4-audit pattern).
